title: Chapter Zero: Welcome to Cicada Creek
author: P. F. Sheckarski
description: A tornadic storm brews outside an economically faltering town in the Great Plains as a traveling outsider attempts to unravel the town's mysteries. This is Chapter Zero (of 8). Further chapters will be released episodically as they are completed. An earlier version of this chapter was awarded second place in IntroComp 2008 (under the title 'Storm Cellar').
